name: Amber tutoring transcripts
summary: Transcripts of 45 online tutoring sessions of about an hour, in which one tutor, Amber, works with an 8th or 9th grader on a single problem about reading a graph, recorded by the XQ Institute in 2022.

license.note: Neither the repository nor its README states a license or terms of use. Edu-ConvoKit's repository holds a copy for a tutorial.

cite: XQ Institute (2022). Amber tutoring transcripts. GitHub. https://github.com/laurenceholt/amber

fits.how: Speech-to-text transcripts of one tutor using productive struggle with many students on the same problem, with no labels: material to read or to label, not yet a check on a judge or a detector.

connect.note: No license is stated, so nothing here fetches it. It has no labels to check a judge or a detector against, and its file names look like dates and initials, which a connector would leave out.
